digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Tuesday, November 3 is anchored by Denver's controlled Amazon Connect go-live and hypercare, with six meetings and an 11:30 AM coverage conflict. Ten unchecked tasks carry forward, including three urgent items. First, confirm launch stability and ownership of the unresolved AI Insights path; then clear the Supabase security warning and lock MHE rollout ownership. Protect the early focus window for close-outs and decide CM CoE coverage before the launch-support block begins. Repository completion state was last updated October 27, so the publish workflow will prune any newer dashboard check-offs before posting.

items.label: Close Denver go-live acceptance and analytics ownership
items.detail: Denver is approved for a controlled launch today, with agent readiness at 10:30 AM ET and hypercare beginning at 11:30 AM AST. Technical validation passed and voicemail and transcription are working, but the AI Insights path remains uncertain: the post-call analysis Lambda may lack an EventBridge trigger, outbound caller-ID control is still an ongoing issue, and Jenn will be unavailable for calls while traveling. Use the 4:00 PM standup to record stability, owners, escalation coverage, and any rollback trigger.

items.label: Remediate the critical Supabase RLS warning
items.detail: The critical security action remains unchecked in repository state. Verify the affected public table, enable the intended protections, and confirm the Security Advisor alert clears during the early focus window.

items.label: Set MHE rollout ownership
items.detail: Confirm the escalation path after Monday's reduced coverage, then assign owners and dates for the remaining intake, disclosure, task-set, provider-state, and rollout work.

items.label: Close the Quality intake-governance loop
items.detail: Record the agreed intake path, ownership, and treatment of the Denial/RFE categorization work now that the TRACE fields project is moving to CoE and Eugenia is coordinating the broader CI discussion.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: This has remained open across multiple daily digests. Finish the short follow-up before the 10:30 AM meeting sequence starts and Module 4 work displaces it again.

items.label: Confirm the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project name
items.detail: Confirm that CLIP is the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project and keep the February 1, 2027 discovery target consistent in the portfolio record.

items.label: Verify the team's Toggl month-end close
items.detail: Check the report for visible gaps and follow up only with teammates whose October entries remain incomplete.

items.label: Decide Eugenia's CoE OKRs dashboard access
items.detail: Approve the appropriate permission level or route the request to the dashboard owner so Eugenia can use the Q4 CoE view.

items.label: Close out Jorge's portfolio-document update
items.detail: Jorge said Monday afternoon that he reviewed the update and it looked complete. Confirm there is no remaining status, owner, or risk gap, then mark the task complete in the dashboard.

items.label: Close the Product-to-EPMO handoff feedback loop
items.detail: Jean endorsed the richer discovery output, especially the transcript context and impacted-department list; Sara clarified that this is the post-discovery handoff, not intake. Confirm whether Sara still needs any additional gap feedback, then close the item.

items.label: 8:00-10:30 AM - Main focus window
items.detail: Use the day's largest uninterrupted block to clear the security action, finish quick aging close-outs, and prepare the Denver acceptance checklist before meetings begin.

items.label: 10:30-11:30 AM - Jhara 1:1 and EPMO slide preparation
items.detail: Close portfolio roadblocks and next owners with Jhara, then move directly into the short slide-preparation block.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Denver hypercare and CM CoE touchpoint overlap
items.detail: Choose coverage before the two sessions start. Denver launch support runs through 7:30 PM AST, while the CM CoE/Product touchpoint occupies the opening 30 minutes; name a delegate or define the readout needed from the session Jean does not attend.

items.label: Noon-3:00 PM - Protected work and EPMO leadership
items.detail: A noon focus block and the open hour from 1:00 to 2:00 PM provide room to document launch decisions and prepare one concise risk-and-owner narrative for the 2:00 PM EPMO TL catch-up.

items.label: 3:30-4:30 PM - Nicolas 1:1 and Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Use the Nicolas 1:1 to resolve portfolio ownership, then move directly into the 4:00 PM deployment review covering stability, outstanding analytics issues, support ownership, and next rollout decisions.

items.label: Reschedule the BD Portfolio Review with Matthew this week
items.detail: Matthew missed Monday's review because his prior meeting ran long and asked to reconvene this week. Find a shared opening and preserve the owner, priority, and risk decisions the review was meant to close.

items.label: Jenn is unavailable for calls today and Wednesday morning
items.detail: Jenn said she will be traveling and can monitor chat but cannot join calls. Confirm another named owner can cover vendor coordination during Denver hypercare.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Thiago 1:1 and Operations Portfolio Review
items.detail: Carry Denver outcomes into the Thiago 1:1, then use the portfolio review to identify shared blockers, approvals, owners, and follow-ups across Phase I, Phase II, and Court work.

items.label: Noon-3:00 PM - Focus window before the afternoon sequence
items.detail: Protect the blocked hour at noon and the open stretch afterward for portfolio follow-through and weekly-meeting preparation.

items.label: 3:30-4:30 PM - Firmwide meeting conflicts with two 4:00 PM blocks
items.detail: The November Firmwide Meeting overlaps both EPMO preparation time and the Amazon Connect standup at 4:00 PM. Choose coverage and secure a deployment readout in advance.
